request.prompt: Premium fantasy mobile RPG skill VFX, hand-painted with luminous volumetric light, bright white-hot cores fading into rich saturated colour, fine sparks and particles, soft glow, NO outlines, NO cartoon line art. IMPORTANT: the whole image is one continuous solid pure black background; every cell sits on the same pure black, no grey, white or coloured cell backgrounds. A sprite sheet: 16 sequential animation frames of ONE effect in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, the effect centred in each cell with black margin all round so nothing touches a cell edge, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. The effect: giant shadowy jaws of a beast rising from the ground at the bottom of each cell and snapping shut: dark violet smoke forms the jaws with glowing magenta fangs and eyes. Frames 1 to 4: the jaws rise open. Frames 5 to 8: they snap shut. Frames 9 to 16: they dissolve into smoke and wisps until the last frame is nearly black.
